name: ad-automation
description: Skeleton workspace for an AI-assisted IT automation demo (backend + frontend).

scripts.dev:runtime: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infrastructure/ad-lab/docker-compose.yml --project-name ad-lab down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose -f infrastructure/ad-lab/docker-compose.yml --project-name ad-lab up -d
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.formatter:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix client run format:check
scripts.formatter:write: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix client run format
